question: Should ClawHub accept the stricter no-case-collision package rule for SKILL.md, skills.md, and PROTOCOL.md while preserving lowercase/legacy aliases?
rationale: The code shape is plausible, but it changes a documented package contract and decides PROTOCOL.md scope, which requires maintainer intent rather than reviewer inference.

options.title: Document and prove the stricter gate
options.body: Record the no-case-collision rule in docs/specs and require redacted live proof before merge.

options.title: Accept the compatibility break as-is
options.body: Merge the stricter validation without more policy text, accepting support risk for existing colliding packages.

options.title: Pause for package-contract direction
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide whether PROTOCOL.md and alias compatibility should be handled differently.

recommendation.title: Document and prove the stricter gate
recommendation.body: Record the no-case-collision rule in docs/specs and require redacted live proof before merge.
